book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Mabholo gha kwakanikiya kwahadabu bhange
“Nkotoka kwahadabuu bhange, na mangota nahadabulwa na Chapanga,
nhwalo chimahadabula bhange, ndi mangota nanhuadabulilwa kipemo cheche, chimwapemela bhange, ndi Chapanga nanhadabulila kwino.
Bho, nhwalo gwa nike mukibhona kipalamande chikibhii muliho lya nnongo gwino, nambo mulibhona jhe lijhola lilibhii muliho lino?
Amu mihoto bhole kunongolela nnongo gwino, Nnongo, denda nimohe lipande muliho lino, kongo nkwete lijhola muliho lino?
Mwenga mukitenda mundo jwaumbone! Mulibhohe hote lijhola lilibhii muliho lino na peniya ndi nanola telatela na kuhoto kubhoha lijhola lilibhii muliho lya nnongo gwino.”
“Nkotoka kwapela ghimbwa ilebhe ya Chapanga, bhahoto kughalambuka na kukachulana mangota amu nkotoka kwataghii magholobhe lwambo ya lulo bhahoto kughatimbatimba kwa magholo ghabhe.
Nnyope na mpalahe na nkong'onde litangala
“Nnyope na mangota napelwa, mupalahangane nampata, nkong'onde litangala na mangota nadindulilwa.
Nhwalo gwenio mundo jhojhoha jwajhopa upelwa, na mundo jhojhoha jwapalaha napata, na jwakong'onda litangala nadindulilwa.
Bho, abhii jhojhoha pakate jhino jwanyopa mwana mundo libumunda, na jwenie napela lighanga?
Amu bho, anda anyopite luhomba, nampela lijhoka?

Anda yenio bhahe, mangota pamonga na gwanganandela gwino, mimanya kwaipela yana hino yambone, chakaka Tate gwino jwa kunane kwa Chapanga natenda kuchocha kwa peniya. Nabhapela ghambone bhala bhibhannyopa.”
“Ghoha ghumipala bhando bhantendele mangota, mwatendele bheniya helahela. Naha ndi chililonge Lilaghalikilo lya Chapanga lyakampekiye Mucha na mabholo gha milondole bha Chapanga.”
Litangala likombaho
“Nnyingile kwa kupete nnyango nkombaho. Kwa nhwalo ndela jhilongocha mukuwegha ndi ngolongwa, na litangala lya kujhingilila mwenio ndi ngolongwa, bhubhajhenda ndela jhenie bhabhii twe.
Nambo ndela jhijhenda mughome gwa machiko ghoha ndi ngombaho, na litangala lya kujhingilila hele likombaho, ndi bhando bhandina tugha bhihoto kuimanya ndela jhene.”
Nkongo na uhohe gwake
“Mukilolekehe na milondole bhuwange. Bhene uhika kwino bhabhonekana ngita mambelele kwa panja, nambo kwa nkate mamehe.
Namamanya kwa mahengo ghabhe. Bho, bhando upochomola mahuku mu mikongo jha mibha, amu ntine mu mikwanga?
Bhahe, nkongo gwambone upambika uhohe gwa mbone, na nkongo gwanganandela upambika uhohe gwanganandela.
Nkongo gwamaha uhoto ng'o kupambika uhohe gwangamanyika, hilu nkongo gwangamanyika uhoto jhe kupambika uhohe ghambone.
Kila nkongo gwangapambika uhohe gwambone naupengulwa na kutagwa pamwotu.
Kwa ngoheno, namamanya kwa mahengo ghabhe.”
Nimanyite jhe mangota
“Chi kila mundo jwangema, ‘Bhambo, Bhambo,’ najhingila Munahota nkolongwa gwa kunane kwa Chapanga, nambo jhola tugha jwahenga ghala ghapala Tate gwango jwabhii kunane kwa Chapanga.
Bhando bhamahele nabhanongolela lichiko lela lya luhadabulo, ‘Bhambo, Bhambo!’ Kwa liina lino tukatangiche malobhe ghino, na kwa liina lino tukabhengite michuka na kuhenga ikangacho twe.
Peniya nanikanila, ‘Niumanyingine ng'o mangota, mmokengane palonge jhango, mangota bhumutenda mabhoho.’
Mapunde bhabhele bhubhachenga
“Bhahe, kwa kila mundo jwajhokanikiya malobhe ghango na kughahenge lihengo, ahwanana na mundo jhuna malango, jwachengite nyumba jhake panane jha lindalabho.
Hula ijhakukoma, ngemba ijhakutwelela, kimbonga kijhapogha na kuhinyuanyua nyumba jhene. Nambo nyumba jhene ikagwii jhe nhwalo ikachengwite panane jha lindalabho.
“Nambo mundo jhojhoha jwajhoha malobhe ghango changaghahenge lihengo, nalandana na mundo jwapumbumwike jwachengite nyumba jhake panane jha ncheke.
Hula ijhakukoma, ngemba ijhakuheluka mache, kimbonga kijhakunyuanyua nyumba jhene, na nyumba jhene ijhakugwegha, na kugwegha kwenio kujhabhehe kukolongwa.”
Ukindendeke gwa Yecho
Yecho pajhomolila kulonge malobhe gheniya, lilongo lya bhando bhajhakukangacha kwa mabholo ghake.
Nhwalo akibha jhe anda bhabhola bheniya bha malaghalikilo, nambo abholita ngita jhuna ukindendeke.
